title: Thunder Substack (by Andreea Popa): Ambition is contagious; the culture around you sets your ceiling
summary: Andreea Popa recounts Cris Pop and Anda's three-week US trip (San Francisco, Las Vegas, New York) and argues that surrounding yourself with driven, trusting people lowers your own threshold for action. She reports Cris attended the New Narratives retreat, joined padel games with strangers who became contacts, and that the team met young Cluj founders.

principles.text: The culture you're in shapes the ceiling you believe exists, so deliberately seek environments that expand it.
principles.quote: The culture you’re in shapes the ceiling you believe exists.

principles.text: Fear of the fall can blind you to how far you could go; in Silicon Valley failure is expected and normal.
principles.quote: We’re so busy avoiding the fall that we forget to look at how far we could go.

principles.text: Trust and co-creation build audacity: questions asked with kindness land as support, not criticism.
principles.quote: That culture of trust and co-creation is what feeds the audacity.

principles.text: Stories of principles lived with real stakes teach better than abstractions.
principles.quote: When you see a principle lived out, applied by a human being, in a real situation with real stakes, it just gets more texture.

principles.text: Reject scarcity thinking: helping others go further costs nothing and can change everything.
principles.quote: scarcity was a lie, and that helping someone else go further costs you nothing and might just change everything.

principles.text: Every connection is an unrevealed door; keep meeting people and invite others along once you start.
principles.quote: Every connection you make is a door that hasn’t revealed itself yet. Go further and meet more people.
